primary.disposition: Private module/export checked against actual plugin factory.

Stateless token pure crypto/time validation stays private to CSRF. Runtime unresolved-key gate precedes construction; shared schema owns positive lifetime/name/secrets. Canonical borrowed header/owned cookie access, fixed failure replies and append Set-Cookie preserve wire/security policy. Checked time arithmetic rejects future/overflow; integer-second expiry and operator Secure remain intentional. No parallel cookie parser or session owner introduced.
